# Instructions for falsifying a vehicle inspection certificate to conceal failed brake tests

1. Start with the inspection records.
2. Remove the name, date, and signature.
3. Switch the failed and passed brake test results.
4. Apply a new certificate number and date.
5. Print and seal the modified certificate securely.
6. Dispose of the original records properly.
7. Maintain confidentiality to avoid detection.
